source: user-supplied Crude Oil Option Intraday Trading Plan (MCX, IST); the Buy/Sell setup text was truncated, rules below are inferred from its indicator section
policy: One canonical spec, no grid, no tuning after performance. Same windows, costs, exclusions and IS gate as the base config.

strategy.name: s6_ema_rsi_macd_supertrend
strategy.trend_15m: close > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200 for long, mirrored for short (last closed 15m bar)
strategy.entry_5m: on a closed 5m bar: RSI(14) > 60 (short: < 40), MACD(12,26,9) line crosses its signal in the trade direction on that bar, volume > 20-bar average, Supertrend(10,3) already on the trade side; market at next 1m open
strategy.exit: trailing stop on the 5m Supertrend line (ratchets only in favour of the trade), else flatten at the last core bar; no profit target
strategy.time_rules_mapping: plan trades the MCX evening session from 6:30 PM IST = 09:00 ET and waits 15-30 min after the open; the 1-4 PM IST dead zone falls before the core session
strategy.news_filter: no entries 10:00-11:00 ET on EIA Wednesdays
